answer_1.quote: In this work, we systematically evaluate multiple open-weight LLMs for cultural text adaptation on closed-text generation.
answer_1.outputs: culturally adapted text in structured format

answer_2.quote: We introduce an Adaptation Score, which measures the correctness of cultural concept replacements.

answer_3.quote: Motivated by recent progress in utilizing large language models to evaluate text generations. We conduct our evaluation using two state-of-the-art LLMs: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Mistral 7B Instruct-v0.3.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we randomly sample 50 adapted generations for each of 7 models, totaling 350 instances.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator is asked to rate the cultural relevance on a 6-point Likert scale (0 = very poor, 5 = perfect) while assuming "Country: India" as a culture proxy.
